decision: Enable 24-hour history: measured compact-memory and replay costs are modest on this workstation; retain hard caps and pace history fetching.
scope: Binance BTC linear perpetual absorption/exhaustion overlay. Detection settings and marker sizing are unchanged.

dataset.source: Existing authenticated recorder coverage and trades.arrow endpoints; OS keychain credentials.
dataset.storage: Temporary client-side CSV only. No server export files or archives created.

method.comparison: Before enabling production 24h, benchmark the existing 4h book and a temporary copy with only HISTORY_MS changed to 24h. Then repeat against the real production module.
method.execution: Release builds, one process at a time, streaming CSV parsing into 25,000-trade batches, five detector rebuilds. External Windows process observer measures peak working set.
method.stress: Repeat 24h with 10-tick bands and a 60-second detection window.
method.units: Bytes are exact measurements or explicitly named estimates; durations are milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds as labeled.
limitations: One day and one workstation do not establish resource use for every market day or configuration.
Compact-book byte counts are allocation estimates, not whole-app RAM.
Worst-case summary estimates include a 64-byte-per-node allowance; they are not exact allocator or process bounds.
The production cross-check ran while the main release build was active, so its rebuild times include contention.
Live-second timings measure detector processing of a summary, not the entire application update/draw pipeline.

Continuity resets remain conservative: idle intervals over 10 seconds or band overflow reset warm-up. Two full-day Balanced resets are not recorder coverage holes; the finer-grid stress case hits the existing overflow guard much more often.
This resource change does not retune the indicator or establish trading profitability.

resource_controls.oversized_millisecond_policy: Grow only up to the existing Arrow limit; fail conservatively if timestamp ties still cannot be paged safely.
resource_controls.timestamp_tie_policy: Drop the capped page's final millisecond and refetch that entire millisecond before advancing.
resource_controls.reload: Existing atomic history swap may temporarily hold live and staged summary books. This is per indicator pane; multiple enabled panes retain separate books.
resource_controls.disk: No raw-trade cache added; use the existing recorder/exchange history pipeline.

native.layout: Layout1, four existing panes retained, Balanced orderflow settings retained.
native.ui: Native chart pan/zoom remained responsive. Zoomed to approximately 20h, loaded older candles, and observed yesterday's NY-session absorption/exhaustion marks. No extra overlay history rebuild was logged during navigation.
native.unrelated_log_error: An existing Bybit historical-kline request returned exchange retCode 10006 during startup. Binance overlay history completed successfully; the Bybit issue was not changed.

server.actions: Read-only coverage/trade requests and resource inspection. No server configuration, restart, deployment or cleanup.
server.disk_note: Disk use grew by 10,199,040 bytes during normal recorder operation. No export or archive was written on the server. Existing approximately 17.25 GiB free space is preserved; unrelated server data was not deleted.

validation.staged_shared_fetcher_fmt: Canonical staged fetcher content rustfmt check: passed
new_regressions: Retain summaries and confirmed marks beyond 4h, then expire them at the new retention horizon.
Request a full day plus warm-up and keep original bounds on retry.
Preserve timestamp ties without loss or duplicates in capped Arrow pages.
Use raw page counts and reject missing timestamp cursors.
Share one initial history budget slot across indicator requests.
validation.shared_file_staging: Only owned orderflow changes staged in kline.rs, fetcher.rs and pane settings; imported unrelated edits remain unstaged.

cleanup.remaining: Small resource receipts and the prior executable/profile rollback copies only. Existing Cargo target reused; unrelated artifacts and server data untouched.
